reason: ₹22,000 is about a full month of what our house earns, and every rupee is going to the wedding right now. A normal semi-automatic costs about half that, and I can just finish the wash by hand when the light goes.
objection: I have never seen this brand on TV. If the battery dies after three years, who will make a new one, and will the dealer even be selling this make by then? With LG or Samsung I know a mechanic will always come.
would_change_my_mind: A big brand I know, like LG, Samsung or Godrej, selling this for around ₹14,000, or the EMI dropping to about ₹1,000 a month after the wedding is over.
